title: CPF Module Schema: CosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-cosmosdbcassandrakeyspace'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

cosmosdb.description: (Required) The name of the CosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace to create the table within. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

enable_autoscale_settings.description: Enable Autoscale settings. Allowed values are true and false. Default is false. This must be set upon database creation otherwise it cannot be updated without a manual terraform destroy-apply.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

max_throughput.description: (Optional) The maximum throughput of the CosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace (RU/s). Must be between 1,000 and 1,000,000. Must be set in increments of 1,000. Conflicts with throughput.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

table_throughput.description: (Required) The throughput of CosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace (RU/s). Must be set in increments of 100. The minimum value is 400. This must be set upon database creation otherwise it cannot be updated without a manual terraform destroy-apply.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource Id of the cosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace.

name.description: The name of the cosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace.

resource.description: The resource information of the cosmosDb Cassandra Keyspace.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Cosmosdbcassandrakeyspace' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
